Job description 
 What will you do?

As a CE Driver (ADR), you will perform irregular international routes throughout Europe. You will operate in a high-stakes environment where safety, precision, and strict adherence to procedures are the top priorities.

    
• 
        
Commute with ease: Depart from home in a company car heading towards Fleurus.

    
    
•

•

•

We are seeking an experienced driver who treats responsibility and discretion with the utmost seriousness.

• 
        
Mindset: A team player who can also excel when working independently.

jobs.occupation: AP Manager | International Finance | Medical Sector
jobs.description:
Permanent | From €6,000 gross/month | Leuven

Thirty countries. Sixty legal entities. A BPO partner in India. Monthly closes under pressure and an ERP migration running straight through live operations. You've been there, and you know exactly how to bring structure, calm and quality to an environment that never stops moving.

 

We're looking for an AP Manager to lead the European AP hub of an international market leader in medical products, based in Leuven. This is a Global Business Services environment with teams spanning Belgium, the UK and India, an active finance transformation programme and products that make a genuine difference in healthcare every single day.

 

 

 

 

 

The Role

As AP Manager, you hold full ownership of the Accounts Payable function and serve as the key link between finance and international business stakeholders. From the European hub in Leuven, you oversee AP operations across Belgium, the United Kingdom and India, working closely with teams distributed around the world.

 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Full AP cycle for European countries: receipt, review, processing and approval of invoices in line with group policy
• Three-way matching, discrepancy follow-up and escalation where required
• Preparation and execution of payment runs across multiple methods (EFT, Wire, ACH, DD, SEPA B2B/B2C)
• Vendor reconciliations, AP subledger alignment with the GL and management of intercompany balances
• Monthly and year-end close activities: accruals, prepayments, open POs and AP adjustments
• Compliance oversight: VAT, Intrastat, SOX requirements, internal controls and segregation of duties
• Building and monitoring KPIs and AP reporting: ageing, vendor spend, payment forecasts and accrual summaries
• Supporting audit processes: providing documentation, explaining reconciliations and implementing recommendations
 

People Management & Leadership

• Managing, coaching and developing international AP teams and BPO partners
• Monitoring SLA quality and operational consistency across outsourced processes
• Providing technical guidance on the ERP system to BPO teams, acting as the go-to for complex processing and system queries
• Visible, engaged leadership: present for your people across time zones and national borders

Your Profile

You're a senior finance professional who knows complex AP environments inside out. You keep your team in sight and know how to introduce structure and composure into an organisation that's constantly evolving.

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a financial discipline
• A minimum of 10 years' relevant experience in AP and GL, ideally across multiple countries and legal entities
• Proven leadership experience, both direct and through BPO coordination and process ownership
• Hands-on knowledge of major ERP systems such as Oracle Cloud Financials or SAP S/4HANA
• Familiar with US GAAP and/or IFRS and financial close across multiple entities
• Strong knowledge of VAT in an international context, SOX and internal controls
• Demonstrable experience with finance transformation or ERP implementation projects is a significant advantage
• Analytical, solutions-focused and comfortable in a high-complexity, fast-changing environment
• Fluent in English (essential); French or Dutch is an advantage
• Willing to travel internationally: regular trips to the UK, occasional travel to Asia

Job description 

Love driving? We’re looking for a CE truck driver for day trips transporting pallets—full or empty, you’ll handle them all!

    
• 
        
Early start: 4–6 a.m.

    
    
•

2–5 stops daily – build great client relationships

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we provide the guidance you need.

Apply now and join our team!

 Requirements 

Your profile To be successful in this role, you meet the following requirements:

    
• Papers: You possess a valid CE driving license and up-to-date Code 95.
    
• Language skills: You can express yourself fluently in Dutch, French, and English. This is essential for communication during international stops.

Job description 

The Adventures of an International Driver
 Are you ready to take the wheel and turn every trip into an adventure? As an international driver, you’ll be transporting goods all across Europe—think the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg, and France—behind the wheel of a sleek tarpaulin truck.

From candy to concrete, meat to zinc on pallets, no two loads are ever the same. It’s like a market of surprises—just with more driving and fewer small talk breaks!

Planning and timing are your superpowers. You’ll keep trips efficient, respect driving and rest rules, and make sure every delivery reaches its destination perfectly. Customers? Think of them as friends—you’ll want to impress every single one.

Flexibility and independence are key. Unexpected challenges? You handle them like a pro. One thing’s for sure: life as an international driver is never boring, always full of variety, and packed with adventure.

 Requirements 

Driving License CE + Code 95 Reliable, Flexible

I can communicate in Dutch, French, and English. That's convenient, right? No language barriers here, just a glass wall full of fun!

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

Are you an experienced pipe fitter who has previously worked in a pharmaceutical environment?

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

In addition to an attractive salary in accordance with PC124, you will receive meal vouchers worth €2.59 per day worked.

Will you be joining our team?
